gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.rationale: Optic Neuritis best explains the relative afferent pupil defect, central scotoma, and impaired color and contrast vision, with strong support from multiple evidence points and no contradictions.

rejected.label: Retinal Vasculitis
rejected.why: While some findings like retinal vessel narrowing and peripapillary hemorrhages could suggest Retinal Vasculitis, they are also compatible with Optic Neuritis and do not contradict it.

rejected.label: Viral retinitis
rejected.why: The presence of viral infection markers does not specifically point to Viral retinitis as the primary diagnosis, given the broader range of symptoms explained by Optic Neuritis.

rejected.label: SARS-CoV-2 infection
rejected.why: Although SARS-CoV-2 infection is confirmed, the ocular symptoms are more specifically explained by Optic Neuritis than by the viral infection itself.
